findings.detail: test-list-per-story.json (and the master test-list.json) contains only T13-T15, all for AC1-table-lists-filed-stock. AC2-quantities-right-aligned, AC3-same-sku-shown-per-location, and AC4-empty-state-shown have zero covering tests, so the story cannot build to green on those ACs. AC2's own architectural_notes already name the missing test explicitly ('Covered by the client Vitest/Playwright harness ... rather than the branch integration suite'), so a client-kind test for right-alignment must be added; AC3 needs a behavior test seeding one SKU at two locations and asserting two distinct rows; AC4 needs a behavior test asserting the empty-state message on a zero-record branch.

acs/AC2-quantities-right-aligned.json, acs/AC3-same-sku-shown-per-location.json, and acs/AC4-empty-state-shown.json are invalid JSON: each file's top-level object closes correctly after `architectural_notes`, but is followed by orphaned trailing lines (`"distinct_from_prior": true, "rationale": ...` plus stray closing braces) left over from a botched edit. All three fail to parse (json.JSONDecodeError: Extra data), which will break any tooling that reads these AC files during the build lane.
